tips.text: Load in, look for the tower, and abort and relaunch if there is none or it has no terminal.
Aim for 6 to 10 minutes a run: Seeker Volley the fighters, missiles or Shatter Burst the Skold shields, then fire the Tycho at a still-glowing engine.
Start on Nsu Grid or H-2 Cloud; the derelict spawns there nearly every run unless a Sentient Anomaly is present.
Ignore advice that names Ruse War Field or Gian Point; Ruse War Field is gone.
Abort after the bonus rewards appear; you keep the cache reward.
Solo, pilot as Hildryn so her shields pay for Railjack abilities, then hand the helm to a Pilot 5 crew gunner from the Tactical menu and swap it back after.
Bring Harrow; his Thurible keeps battle avionics topped up when you get plenty of kills.
Spread the tries over many short sessions instead of one long grind.
Nsu Grid pays Endo and credits even when no Spectra Vandal drops.
Budget about 30 paid-out caches for a full set, with a long tail; cut mission time before anything else.
